I would like to express my sincere and heartfelt gratitude to Sara's Elderly Care for the wonderful care they provided to my father.
He was on dialysis and dealing with multiple age-related health issues, and it had become extremely difficult for us to manage everything at home. From day one, the team showed compassion, professionalism, and genuine concern for his well-being. Knowing he was in a clean, safe, and caring environment gave us immense peace of mind. We are truly grateful.

featured_reviews.name: Tanushree Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share my sincere and heartfelt gratitude to Sara’s Elderly Care / Vriddhashram for the wonderful care they provided to my father. He was on dialysis and dealing with multiple age-related health issues, and it had become extremely difficult for us to manage everything at home.

From the very first day, the team showed compassion, professionalism, and genuine concern for his well-being. The caregivers were patient and attentive, ensuring he received his medications and dialysis-related support on time. They kept us informed regularly and treated my father with the dignity and respect he deserved.

A special mention to Rahul Singh and Vicky, who cared for him with exceptional compassion, patience, and dedication. They consistently made sure his needs were met and went beyond routine care—spending time with him, comforting him, and helping him feel at home during a very challenging phase of his life. What gave us immense peace of mind was knowing he was in a clean, safe, and caring environment.

My father passed away while under their care, and during that incredibly difficult time, Rahul went above and beyond to help us. He assisted in arranging the necessary documentation and coordinated the transfer to the crematory. His calm presence and willingness to manage these responsibilities made an overwhelming situation a little easier for us to navigate.

The entire team at Sara’s Elderly Care treated my father with respect, warmth, and humanity, and for that I am truly grateful. Losing a parent is never easy, but knowing he was looked after by people who genuinely cared brought us comfort.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Sara’s Elderly Care to anyone seeking a responsible, compassionate, and trustworthy place for their loved ones.
